user.title: Connect your Vertigo locally
user.description: Enter your device's parameters. Close OS Home and disable other local integrations for this device before testing the connection. The local key must contain 16 characters. No cloud account is required after key retrieval.

reconfigure.title: Update the local connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address and current local key. Device ID remains unchanged.

error.invalid_credentials: Enter a valid address, device ID and a 16-byte local key.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the device. Check address, key, firewall and other clients using the device.
